author: PokerFace
body:
Hello everyone, Bloodoh and I have been working on a TE TDM map for a couple days. We really liked the clay theme used in many maps so we used that and just converged our ideas together. Without further ado, we present to you Campus!

There will be a gapple spawner in the middle as well as 2 arrow spawners on each side. The map is also completely enclosed in a box so we will ensure that there is permanent night vision enabled for this map in the YML.

There are also scoreboxes. Each time you get in will give your team 2 points.

Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/nBetP
Download: Soon! (Just gotta add spawners and review feedback)
YML: Fouled will be taking care of us :D


Any feedback you have is appreciated. Thanks!
